deviation: The draft lets the SOW override the MSA whenever it "expressly states" it overrides a specific provision, so the MSA no longer always prevails. A SOW could then dilute MSA liability, IP, data protection or audit terms, which the playbook prohibits. The draft also drops the express statement that those MSA terms apply to the SOW.
suggested_text: 1.3 This SOW is issued under, and governed by, the Master Services Agreement identified in the header block (the "Parent Agreement"). Capitalised terms not defined in this SOW have the meanings given in the Parent Agreement. If there is a conflict, the Parent Agreement prevails over this SOW. The liability, indemnity, intellectual property, confidentiality, data protection, audit and governing law terms of the Parent Agreement apply to this SOW.
